name: Pendant
summary: A small wearable microphone records conversations through the day, transcribes them and turns them into a searchable memory the agent can query. It gives an agent context about meetings and spoken commitments that never reach a screen.
facts: Pendant, 10-14 h battery, MCP server in repo
Wrist or clip, up to 7 days battery, $74.99
Limitless stopped selling its Pendant on Dec 5, 2025 after joining Meta
goodFor: Feeding agents context from offline life
watchOut: Recording others raises consent and legal issues
Vendors can be acquired and shut down
Transcripts of everything are sensitive data
how: Wear a recording pendant or clip that streams audio to a phone app
Audio is transcribed and summarised into memories and tasks
Expose the memory store to the agent, for example over MCP
The agent searches past conversations when answering or planning
